name: Transmission fluid sensor - MIL request over CAN
description: The TCM has no MIL of its own. When its fluid temperature sensor shorts to battery it stores P0713, uses a substitute temperature and asks the ECM over CAN to light the lamp - which is why the ECM stores P0700.

steps.note: Waiting for the cluster bulb check to finish
The sensor signal wire shorts to battery voltage - the ECU input clamps at 5 V
1. The TCM sees 5 V on an NTC input: circuit high, P0713
The TCM sends a substitute 80 degC so the shift strategy keeps working
2. TCM_Status.TcmMilReq: the TCM asks for the MIL
3. The ECM, owner of the MIL, stores P0700 and lights the lamp
No limp mode: a substitute temperature is good enough to keep shifting
Mode 03 to 0x7DF: the TCM reports P0713, the ECM P0700
Mode 04 clears both modules with one functional request
